answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond before it can trade, and let peers slash that bond when they catch a fake identity. A single honest agent risks little, but a Sybil farmer spinning up a whole grove of sock-puppets must fund each one, and every exposed puppet burns its bond. Like umber veins running through marble, the cost is baked into the identity itself: forging many cheap selves stops being cheap, because each new face carries a real price.
